entries.stage: After formal training jobs started, before any confirmation/audit fixture generation or inspection.
entries.trigger: Independent algebra and probability-law tests found that using clamped event probability as a conditional-mass denominator changes transition row mass and conditional tail ratios.

observed_legacy_example.source: Independent mathematics reviewer; exact source/test evidence archived by that reviewer.

entries.registered_dt1_corner_scope: Reviewer measured maximum row-mass error 7.11e-13 on 27 allowed-bound dt=1 corners. This does not make the general finite transition valid outside those sampled corners.
entries.decision: Fix the probability-normalization implementation, retain legacy source/tests and every old fit/cost, and rerun all five secondary temperature seeds without selecting by task performance.
entries.cost_rule: Count all legacy and corrected attempts in total research cost. Do not include superseded legacy temperature checkpoints in final efficacy lookup.
entries.source_binding: Keep per-job source hashes at training start. Already-running jobs imported the old temperature class; changing the file does not repair those in-memory jobs. Primary modes do not call that class.
entries.confirmation_leakage: No confirmation outcome informed this implementation correction. Final source/protocol/checkpoint freeze is still pending.

scope: T=1 reproduces the base FPT law up to row-normalization roundoff.
Exact zero, exact one, p=1e-20 and near-one probabilities preserve mass, active conditional distribution, and event direction.
Trainable parameter count remains matched with diffusion fixed and one learned temperature.
Full task-return temperature derivative agrees with finite differences.
Actual small-dt CTMC rows conserve probability and have finite temperature gradients.

entries.attempt_count_scope: Formal registered fits and superseded temperature attempts; development/smoke training is additional, retained and separately costed.
entries.eligibility_rule: study.checkpoint_path uses explicit model/ablation/seed-to-directory registration. Temperature is eligible only from fits_temperature_corrected. Retained original-path or legacy copies cannot become eligible, even if corrected files are absent; absence must reject, never fall back.
entries.statistics_selection_rule: Statistical fitting/cost eligibility uses the sixty registered entries and their hashes rather than directory glob counts. Superseded and duplicate copies stay raw evidence and are not additional successful attempts.

entries.stage: Before final freeze and before any confirmation fixture generation or inspection.
entries.trigger: A 96-trajectory development runner used internal RNG namespace 900000000 before the development override was added. Later development uses 880000000.
entries.decision: Move confirmation internal RNG base from 900000000 to 920000000 for every registered regime/fit/episode, before confirmation; retain all other seed formulas and sample sizes.
entries.rationale: Keep confirmation internal innovations disjoint from already observed development innovations. This is a pre-confirmation namespace correction, not outcome selection.
entries.confirmation_leakage: Coordinator reports no confirmation was generated or inspected; source/protocol/checkpoint freeze is still pending.
